nodes.description: Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Total token supply storage variable, read by totalSupply() and set by the URToken constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance, written by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval and consumed by transferFrom.
Public token name string, assigned once in the URToken constructor.
Public token symbol string, assigned once in the URToken constructor.
Public token decimals value, assigned once in the URToken constructor.
Constant initial supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Multiplies two uint256 values and asserts that the result does not overflow.
Integer division of two uint256 values; reverts automatically on division by zero.
Subtracts two uint256 values and asserts the subtrahend is not greater than the minuend.
Adds two uint256 values and asserts the result is greater than or equal to the first operand.
Public view returning the stored totalSupply_ value.
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to after balance checks.
Public view returning the balance of the queried owner address.
Moves tokens from _from to _to using the allowance granted to msg.sender.
Sets the allowance that msg.sender grants to _spender (classic approve race-condition pattern).
Public view returning the remaining allowance of _spender for _owner.
Increases the allowance msg.sender granted to _spender by _addedValue.
Decreases the allowance msg.sender granted to _spender by _subtractedValue, flooring at zero.
Deployer constructor that sets metadata, total supply and the deployer's full balance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and mint recipient.
